records.source_excerpt:
38. Executive Council of the African Union ma kes decision by_______
A. 1/3 majority vote B. discretion C. cons ensus D. the veto of the General S ecretariat
records.hold_reason: The Executive Council seeks consensus but can decide substantive matters by a two-thirds majority when consensus fails. The unrestricted stem and options omit that fallback and need the full decision rule.

original_record.question: The constitution of any given country must provide for

options.B: the rights and duties of the individual

records.source_excerpt:
39: The constitution of any given country must provide for
A. the distribution of powers B. the rights and duties of the individual C. the rule of law
D. none of the above E. A, B and C
records.hold_reason: Must conflates descriptive constitutional content with normative ideals. Not every constitution guarantees the rule of law or explicitly lists individual duties, so all-of-the-above cannot be treated as a universal requirement.
